Type-1 ZONING NARRATIVE AND PLANS
M1-1 to C2-1 MAP AMENDMENT
10209-10257 SOUTH TORRENCE AVENUE

Narrative:

The Applicant, ATG, LLC, is seeking a map amendment from M1-1 District to C2-1 Type-1 Motor Vehicle
Related Commercial District in order to allow the construction of a proposed 1 Story Retail Shopping
Center, and 1 Story building for Mini-Mart/Gas Fueling Station.

The property is a vacant lot.

Applicant is seeking to develop a 11,200 sq. ft. Food Mart, Gas Fueling Station, 14 pumps, Zero feet North
of 103" street, with 18 Parking spaces, (1) ADA parking spaces, 6 parking spaces for Charging Electric
Cars, and (1) parking space for an Air Tire pump for customers.

The applicants also is seeking to develop a 12,400 sq. ft. Retail Shopping Center, 259 feet North of 103
St. with 53 parking spaces and (2) ADA parking space to be used for the customers.

Bulk Table:
* Lot Area to be redeveloped: 94,763 sq. ft.

* Proposed Buildings Size: Mini-Mart: 11,200 sq. ft. + Retail Shopping Center 12,400 sq. ft.
Total Building Size: 23,600 sq. ft.

(a) Floor Area Ratio: 0.25
(b) Density: No residential Not applicable.
(c) Off-Street Parking: 69 on-site parking spaces.
(d) Setbacks:
Front: 87.0 Feet.
Rear: 28.0 Feet.
North Side: 56.0 Feet.
South Side: 55.0 Feet.

(e) Tow Building Height: 22 feet and 8 inches. (Proposed)
